profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Amazon Lab126 | PhD
profile.summary: With over eight years of experience in software engineering and academic research, I am a passionate and innovative Software Developer at Amazon Lab126. I work with a talented team to design, develop, and test software solutions for consumer devices. Before joining Amazon Lab126, I was an assistant professor at UDLAP and Tecnológico de Monterrey, where I taught courses on software engineering, app development, and databases, and published several papers on image and video compression, and artificial inteligence. I am driven by curiosity, creativity, and collaboration, and I strive to deliver high-quality and impactful software products that enhance user experience and satisfaction.
